title: Règles officielles du marché
text:
This market refers to the tennis match between Ryo Tabata and Felipe Meligeni Alves in the Florianopolis, originally scheduled for November 24, 2026 at 1:00PM ET.
This market will resolve to "Ryo Tabata" if Ryo Tabata wins by 2 or more sets than Felipe Meligeni Alves, based on the final completed score. Otherwise, it will resolve to "Felipe Meligeni Alves."
If the match begins but is not completed due to retirement, default, or disqualification, this market will resolve 50-50, unless the outcome of this market has already been unconditionally determined by the completed portion of play under the match format published by the tournament organizer for that round. For example, if the deciding set has begun when the match ends, Ryo Tabata can no longer win by 2 or more sets, and this market will resolve to "Felipe Meligeni Alves."
If the match is canceled before play begins, or a result has not been determined by December 8, 2026, 11:59 PM ET (14 days after the scheduled start), this market will resolve 50-50.
Resolution will be based on official Challenger results.
